qualification: Implemented and locally tested. No push, merge, deploy, firewall change, production database or real upstream IA/Web Push/FCM call. Final Node 22/Linux and physical/external qualification remain separate.
decision: Central deployment-controlled outbound policy and bounded pinned-IP HTTPS for tenant-controlled AI and Web Push URLs.

controls.origins: Exact canonical HTTPS origins, public port 443, no credentials/fragment/wildcards; AI query denied, push capability query preserved only for its approved endpoint.
controls.dns: Per-operation cancellable resolver, all A and AAAA validated; no second lookup, no shared connection agent.
controls.addresses: Public profiles deny private/special/metadata/transition/mapped addresses. IPv6 conservatively 2000::/3 excluding special ranges.
controls.privateAi: Deployment-only exact origin/port and exact RFC1918/ULA addresses; never inherited by Web Push or tenant flags. AWS/Google metadata ULA prefixes and Azure infrastructure virtual address also denied.
controls.tls: Pinned IP, original Host/SNI, explicit CA/hostname verification and remote IP check before req.end sends HTTP credentials/body.
controls.redirects: All non-2xx, including 3xx, rejected; no redirects, cookies, retries or global proxy agent.
controls.response: Streaming byte bound with/without Content-Length, no decompression; connection closed on error/abort/deadline.
controls.logging: Static purpose/reason, no endpoint token, credential, arbitrary upstream response or error body. Private route configuration is logged only as count and SHA256 digest.
controls.webPush: Official SDK VAPID/encryption via generateRequestDetails; bounded common transport replaces sendNotification. Location no longer persisted as message ID.

integration.upstreamNetwork: Prohibited in new SSRF cases; controlled DNS only

realTlsGate.interface: Local RFC1918 interface, ephemeral synthetic HTTPS server
realTlsGate.injected: Controlled resolver and synthetic CA trust only; real HTTPS sockets, policy and peer checks
cases: DNS changed next request; no second connect lookup
wrong TLS identity sends no credentials
global TLS bypass does not override explicit validation

intermediateFailures: Parameterized Jest table and mock types fixed; no product assertions weakened.
Harness blanks unknown app envs, so explicit safe public origin defaults added for positive integration fixtures.
Full unit gate exposed a pre-existing Supertest implicit-listener socket hang up; personal-preference fixture now listens on loopback for its whole suite.
Initial restricted NPM audit had no registry result; repeated with registry access and policy passed.
deploymentRequirements: Inventory and approve existing integration/push origins before API rollout.
Use consistent lists and private route policy in every sender replica/worker.
No migration needed; no server operation performed.
Do not restore arbitrary destinations as rollback.
